facts.claim: Listed for Web Summit Lisbon 2026 (LIS26) on its own appearance page: Hablla, Brazil, Advertising, content & marketing, a startup in the Growth track.
Its Web Summit pitch says Hablla One "automates customer conversations with AI across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email and phone"; it does not use the word agent.
On ApexBrasil's list of companies approved for its Web Summit Lisboa 2026 mission (by CNPJ), status "Confirmado" on 28 August 2026.
